name: pypy-review-toolkit
description: 10 agents and 4 commands for reviewing PyPy's RPython interpreter core, object space, JIT, and lib_pypy: translated()/untranslated() divergence, JIT immutability-contract auditing, interp/app boundary leak detection, RPython-restriction scanning (kwargs only, v0.1), qualitative JIT-trace review, git-history analysis, CFFI/native-resource lifecycle triage, and within-class and cross-class guard-consistency triage.
